reviewer: Claude Code (AI assistant), not yet confirmed by the team
method: Each flagged claim compared with the data the bot received (eval/runs/v13/results.json) and with the system prompt, which the judge does not see. Only flagged answers were reviewed; unflagged answers were not re-checked.

items.claim: Máy iPhone của bạn vẫn trong thời hạn bảo hành 12 tháng
items.reason: The customer says the phone was bought 2 months ago; search_knowledge_base returned 'Thời hạn bảo hành điện thoại là 12 tháng ... kể từ ngày nhận hàng'. 2 months is within 12 (also flagged in v12).

Sample Store visitor in guest mode. The system prompt for guests states 'the visitor is not logged in' (agent_server/prompts.py); the judge sees tool results and system context only, not the system prompt.

items.claim: A 20W adapter plus the Lightning cable would cover it; the Ugreen Mini 20W is the cheapest and best rated of the chargers
items.reason: The prices and ratings are in the search_products results (444,000₫ is the lowest; 5.0 is the highest rating, shared with the Ugreen Pro). The pairing advice 'a 20W adapter plus the Lightning cable would cover it' is a recommendation no tool states (the same sentence was flagged in v10 and v12).

not_judged.why: AI Box stalled in the middle of the answer; the turn ended with the error event, so there is no answer to judge (89 of 90 answers judged).
